name: AiChatDrawer
title: Templates/Platform/AI/AiChatDrawer
summary: The generative AI assistant in a right-side drawer over a resource page, so the reader asks about what they are looking at without leaving it: a workload page (`PageHeader` with an Ask AI `Button`, a `Card` of `KeyValuePairs` with a `StatusIndicator`) behind a medium `Drawer` whose `PanelHeader` holds `DrawerTitle`, a Preview `Tag`, New chat and `DrawerClose`. Inside, an `EmptyState` with support prompts about this workload (`SuggestionGroup`), then a `Conversation` with every message at the inline start, responses that think (`Reasoning`), stream (`StreamingResponse`), cite (`Sources`) and carry Copy, Regenerate and feedback, and a `PromptInput` pinned at the foot with the disclaimer. Built from `Drawer`, `DrawerPortal`, `DrawerOverlay`, `DrawerContent`, `DrawerTitle`, `DrawerClose`, `PanelHeader`, `ChatMessage`, `Conversation`, `PromptInput`, `IconButton` and `CopyButton`. A page body for ConsoleLayout, rendered in its default slot.
intents: asistente de ia en panel lateral

variants.name: Streaming
variants.summary: The drawer open on a response streaming in about the 502 errors of the workload behind it, with the caret, Stop in the composer and the busy region.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: A response that failed mid-stream inside the drawer: the partial text, the error line and Try again.

variants.name: LongThread
variants.summary: Six earlier turns about the workload in the narrow drawer: the log opens on the newest response and Scroll to the latest message returns after scrolling up.
